items.title: You Won't Believe Everything They're Adding To Dandy's World...
items.description:
Dandy's World doesn't feel like a roblox game anymore. They have fully outgrown the platform in its own entity, truly. We have two new lethals coming tomorrow, a whole new labs gamemode with new machines, so much new lore, secret folders for each toon, dessa, a new currency ambrosia, ichorlings, a new gamepass and literally so so so much more. This really does just feel like the new beginning of dandys world bro. holy snot.
